note: Per-cell element ledger derived from HGSS land_data. lab: T rock top, E/S/W/N rock face by downhill direction, L jump south, K jump east, O boulder, R sea rock, X other blocked (buildings, props), ~ water, . open. floor: ground under open cells (shallow: the walkable surf strip). peak: HGSS cell maximum height (terrace level = peak - 1).
